$comment: Job templates of the wholesale_b2b business type (jobs contract section 5). DRAFT: every customer-facing text is for a native reader to check before it goes live. Written for distributors and wholesalers whose buyers are dealers and shops. No price, discount, delivery promise, refund promise or guarantee anywhere; templates are for enquirers and consenting customers only; the researcher template never calls or messages prospects (the owner reaches out personally). The invented prospects are fictional.
